# Install `admin` — Admin — Generic Shell

> HEADLESS admin scaffold — no chrome of its own; pair with dashboard-shell for app chrome.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/admin
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=admin
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/admin

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add admin
# alias: npx rr add admin
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `infra`, `admin`, `shell`, `crud`, `nav-from-registry`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `rr add admin`. Wire <AdminPage labels={...} /> at /admin and call buildAdminStats({ sliceRegistry, queryTable }) inside convex/features/admin/query.ts — sliceRegistry.entries flat-maps each feature's admin.activity[] declarations. Set SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL via `npx convex env set` to lock down /admin to one address.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
- All Convex queries hit an index (`.withIndex(...)`); never bare `.collect()`.
- Public mutations/queries declare `args:` validators + authz.
- Full ruleset: https://resource.rahmanef.com/best-practice
